/kind bug
<!--
Add one of the following kinds:

/kind feature

Optionally add one or more of the following kinds if applicable:
/kind api-change
/kind deprecation
/kind failing-test
/kind flake
/kind regression
-->

#### What this PR does / why we need it:
When the server stopped before timeout, the `stopped <-true` will be executed and in the select block, the first case will be chosen. This will lead to a hanging goroutine at line 111 because no receiver of `timeout` is left. Changing the `timeout` chan to a buffered one can fix it.
#### Which issue(s) this PR fixes:

-->

issue_context.title: Goroutine leak in EtcdMigrateServer
issue_context.body:
### What happened?
It's at [migrate_server.go](https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/master/cluster/images/etcd/migrate/migrate_server.go) line 111

When the server stopped before timeout, the first goroutine will be block on  `timeout <- true` because the receiver in the second goroutine is not exist. 
Changing `timeout` to a buffered one may fix it. #114071 
```
	stopped := make(chan bool)
	timedout := make(chan bool)
	go func() {                                   // first goroutine
		time.Sleep(gracefulWait)
		timedout <- true                // blocked
	}()
	go func() {                                   // second goroutine
		select {
		case <-stopped:
			return                          // return here
		case <-timedout:
			klog.Infof("etcd server has not terminated gracefully after %s, killing it.", gracefulWait)
			r.cmd.Process.Kill()
			return
		}
	}()
	err = r.cmd.Wait()
	stopped <- true
```

### What did you expect to happen?

no goroutine leaks

### How can we reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible)?

run related test with leak checker
